From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: POC follow-up: prompt set & success criteria (next steps)

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about Acme AI's recommendation workflow and the evaluation goals for the POC. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared checklist.

Recap / Success criteria (from our call):
- Functional: Redwood must integrate with your prompt/response pipeline and support your prompt types (multi-turn product-retrieval + instruction-style prompts).
- Quality: POC target is >= 85% pass rate on your human-evaluated prompt set for top-1 generation (customer-defined rubric).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 200 ms for 512-token max responses on our Dedicated config.
- Cost/Throughput: Baseline cost metric and ability to sustain your expected daily traffic (we'll capture QPS).

Proposed evaluation plan / ownership:
- Acme: provide a representative prompt set + 4 weeks of anonymized logs (or a 2k prompt sample) and the human-eval rubric.
- Redwood (Dev): implement ingestion, mapping, and run initial evals.
- Redwood (SRE/Eng): set up dedicated POC runtime and monitor latency/cost.
- Timeline: initial data due by Mon 2026-02-23, POC run and first results by Fri 2026-03-06.

Can you confirm the prompt file format (CSV with columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, context, expected_behavior) and that Acme can share a 2k-sample by 2026-02-23? If helpful, you can send a smaller seed set first and we'll start with that.

Attachments we will send from Redwood: POC Method of Procedure (redwood_poc_mop_v1.pdf).

Next actions:
1) Jordan: send sample prompts + rubric + any guardrail lists (blocked phrases) — by 2026-02-23.
2) Aditya / Dev: ingest sample, propose eval script and metrics (QA) — by 2026-02-25.
3) Kickoff call w/ Eng & SRE to schedule runtime and data ingestion — propose Tue 2026-02-24 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward.

--

Jordan — great, thanks for the seed. Looping in Dev (engineering) and Laura (Customer Success) so we have clear ownership. Quick notes from our side: 

Engineering plan (Dev):
- Ingest CSV, normalize contexts, and run a small warm-up evaluation on the seed set to validate parsing.
- Implement evaluation harness: metrics we propose to capture per-prompt: human_score (from Acme), model_pass (binary), response_text, token_count, latency_ms, model_confidence (if available).

Evaluation rubric (proposed):
- Primary: alignment with human_score (top-1) — target >= 85% pass rate on full set.
- Secondary: mean latency and 95th pctl latency target (<200ms).
- Operational: error rate (5xx/timeout) < 1% over the run.

Data & security: please confirm anonymization steps for logs; we'll handle ingestion over secure Drive share or S3 presigned link.

Timeline / next steps (updated):
- 2026-02-23: Acme sends full 2k sample + rubric + logs link.
- 2026-02-25: Redwood completes initial ingest + baseline eval on sample.
- 2026-03-03: First full-run results and quality review call.

Thanks —
